description: Named cases for #248 (D046): candidate v1.14.0's rulings from the owner's #232 spot-check (2026-11-18) and #248's template-stock finding (2026-11-03), one case per source row, with the owner's ruling as 'expected'. Strata say whether v1.13.0 got the row wrong: 'v114_correction_*' rows are ones v1.13.0 stored and the owner corrected (#232's seven corrections, R1 and R2; #248's seven template rows; #249's Digital row), and 'v114_guard_*' rows are #232 confirmations v1.14.0 must not break (R1's other side, R3 to R6). #238's two futures-wrap cases in product_and_stability.json ('a7eeaa13', 'b8891fbc', re-ruled financial under R3) carry 'v114_correction_r3'. D046's roll-up scores each family on its verdict, ruled categories and ruled sentiments; its falsifier reads the corrections. On a multi-brand row the note names the scored brand; the others are read by hand. 'title' is the stored title, kept so the prompt-example check runs without the database. 'owner_ruled' (#275, D045): true when the case's expectation is the owner's ruling on the article, which must then be in HUMAN_RULINGS at the status it maps to (not sportswear: false_positive; ruled categories: labeled; ruled no category: skipped); false when the article is ruled but this brand's expectation is not its ruling (a multi-brand article). Every case here is true. 7f3d37d8 (a Nike stock-move wrap named in #248) is left out until the owner rules it.
